svg.aria-label: Specific gamma-ray constants against two published tabulations
svg.text: Specific gamma-ray constants against two published tabulations
residual against each table's own units, vacuum, at that table's cutoff
Each block is compared in its own source's units and against its own stated cutoff -- 20 keV for Ninkovic & Adrovic, 15 keV for
Smith & Stabin -- so only the residual is common to the figure. Rows drawing more than 30% of the constant from below 100 keV are
reported rather than gated: there the air table is sparse, its energy-absorption coefficient is turning over at its Compton
minimum, and X-ray intensities differ between compilations.
